tools.description: Read one bounded page of drafts within the trusted host scope. reviewStatus and onlyPossibleDuplicates are filters, not evidence of a match. Results are masked application observations; use only returned ids/revisions and do not infer missing values, confirmation, or financial authority.
tools.name: query_draft_candidates

query.description: Required filter object for a bounded query of actual in-scope draft rows; filters do not establish an event/draft association.

bounds.description: Required page bounds; both limit and offset must be supplied.

limit.description: Required maximum page size; integer from 1 through 500 inclusive.

onlyPossibleDuplicates.description: Required boolean filter. true returns only drafts the application marks as possible duplicates; false does not assert that any returned row matches.

reviewStatus.description: Required; null disables this filter, otherwise only the exact listed application status is selected.

tools.description: Store or revise one source-grounded occurrence from the current observeCaptureContext masked text. Revisions and UTF-16 offsets must come from that observation; spanStart is inclusive, spanEnd exclusive, and maskedSpanText must exactly equal the copied range. Sensitive scalar amount/date/time values are same-session opaque tokens or null. Each scalar token value is the complete displayed token, including its literal opening ⟦ and closing ⟧ delimiters; never submit only the text between them. Shapes such as ⟦AMT-…⟧, ⟦DATE-…⟧, and ⟦TIME-…⟧ are illustrative only, not valid or copyable tokens; copy an actual full token from the current masked observation. Never provide raw, reconstructed, or abbreviated literals. Amounts and times must be grounded in the source or explicit user clarification. A date token may come from the source or an explicit user-supplied absolute date clearly applying to this occurrence; do not derive a relative target unless its exact same-session DATE token is already available in masked context. If not, leave date null and clarify. A grounded occurrence may be stored with unresolved fields null; amountVnd=null requires a nonblank unresolvedReason. Clarify without writing when the occurrence/span itself is not grounded. Date-only anchors have no timezone; the adapter supplies the trusted capture timezone only for a stated time. Operation identity is host-owned; this tool does not confirm financial records.
tools.name: update_event_interpretation

captureId.description: Required positive id of a capture granted by the host and present in the current observation; never guess or widen scope.

expectedCaptureRevision.description: Required non-negative revision copied from the current observeCaptureContext result; stale revisions conflict.

expectedEventRevision.description: Required nullable compare-and-set revision: null for a new reading/span, otherwise the current event revision from the same observation.

extractionVersion.description: Required non-empty provenance label for the extraction contract; it grants no authority and is not an operation key.

amountVnd.description: Optional nullable same-session AMT token. Copy the complete token exactly as displayed, including its literal ⟦ and ⟧ delimiters; never submit only the inner text. The shape ⟦AMT-…⟧ is illustrative only, not a valid or copyable token. Use null/omit when no amount is stated or it is uncertain. Never supply a raw amount or infer it from a draft; when null, the service requires a nonblank unresolvedReason.

merchant.description: Optional nullable merchant text grounded in this source span or explicit user clarification; preserve any opaque tokens exactly and use null/omit when unstated or uncertain. Do not infer it from a draft or similar transaction.

maskedSpanText.description: Required non-empty exact copy of sourceText[spanStart:spanEnd] from the current masked observation; do not abbreviate or alter tokens.

normalizedText.description: Required non-empty normalized wording for this grounded occurrence; stay within its observed source meaning and preserve opaque tokens exactly.

spanEnd.description: Required exclusive UTF-16 end offset in the exact current masked source view; it must be greater than spanStart and no greater than sourceText.length.

spanStart.description: Required inclusive UTF-16 start offset in the exact current masked source view; it must be non-negative and the range must not split an opaque token.

timeAnchor.description: Optional nullable date/time object. Omit or use null if no date/time is grounded; use only same-session typed tokens from source or explicit user clarification/reference. Relative dates require an explicit anchor and an exact available DATE token; never construct a raw or unavailable date.

date.description: Optional nullable same-session DATE token. Copy the complete token exactly as displayed, including its literal ⟦ and ⟧ delimiters; never submit only the inner text. The shape ⟦DATE-…⟧ is illustrative only, not a valid or copyable token. A date-only anchor is valid and has no timezone. For relative wording, use only an exact resolved DATE token already present in masked context; otherwise leave null and clarify.

intervalEndDate.description: Optional nullable same-session DATE token for an explicitly stated interval end from source or user clarification. Copy the complete token including literal ⟦ and ⟧ delimiters, not only its inner text; ⟦DATE-…⟧ is illustrative only and not a value to submit. Requires a start date and cannot precede it.

intervalEndTime.description: Optional nullable same-session TIME token for an explicitly stated interval end from source or user clarification. Copy the complete token including literal ⟦ and ⟧ delimiters, not only its inner text; ⟦TIME-…⟧ is illustrative only and not a value to submit. Requires an interval end date and a start time.

time.description: Optional nullable same-session TIME token for an explicitly stated start wall-clock time from source or user clarification. Copy the complete token including literal ⟦ and ⟧ delimiters, not only its inner text; ⟦TIME-…⟧ is illustrative only and not a value to submit. If present it requires a start date. The timezone is host-owned and is not a model argument.

unresolvedReason.description: Optional nullable explanation of a field left unreadable/uncertain; must be nonblank when amountVnd is null. Never fill an unresolved field by inference.

tools.description: Propose a tentative pair using only current observed eventId and draftId values inside host scope. The application computes and rechecks link evidence from stored rows; never infer an association from similar text, amount, or date and never supply evidence. This does not attach, confirm a draft, or write a ledger row. The actual result includes a fresh currentPair state/revision when one exists. Operation identity is opaque and host-owned.
tools.name: propose_link

draftId.description: Required positive id from the current bounded draft observation and trusted session scope; never guess an identifier.

eventId.description: Required positive id from the current observeCaptureContext event observation and trusted session scope.

tools.description: Attach only the exact previously proposed event/draft pair after observing its currentPair state and revision. The application rechecks unique stored-row evidence; ambiguity remains for the user. userOverride must be JSON null; any non-null value is a terminal user_decision_required refusal. This creates no user confirmation or ledger transaction. The actual result includes a fresh currentPair; operation identity is opaque and host-owned.
tools.name: attach_link

draftId.description: Required positive id of the same scoped draft in the observed proposed pair.

eventId.description: Required positive id of the same scoped event in the observed proposed pair.

expectedRevision.description: Required non-negative compare-and-set revision copied from the latest proposed currentPair observation; stale revisions conflict and must be refreshed.

userOverride.description: Required JSON null. The agent cannot supply a user-only evidence override; any string is refused as user_decision_required.

tools.description: Request only the application's existing local, review-only Laya suggestion for a scoped draft. Copy its current masked description and reviewRevision from query_draft_candidates; the adapter compares the masked preview and classifies the authoritative stored description, not caller text. A mismatch returns context_mismatch with fresh masked description/revision. This does not choose a category or write a ledger record. Operation identity is opaque and host-owned.
tools.name: request_laya_classification

description.description: Required copy of the current masked classification description from the scoped draft observation; this is a freshness/context precondition, not a category instruction. On context_mismatch, use the actual fresh masked description returned by the application.

draftId.description: Required positive id of a draft present in the current bounded query and granted host scope.

expectedReviewRevision.description: Required non-negative compare-and-set revision copied from the current bounded draft observation; null is not valid for the agent tool because it would disable the freshness check.
